limitations: Dictionary postdates the essay. No image collation or unique contextual reading is established.
A weighted finite-occasion measure is an operational candidate, not a definition prescribed by Adelung.
The independent-reasoned-judgment reading does not cover every form of thinking.

observations.Hang: The entry describes a noticeable degree of inclination, including recurring tendencies. It does not require knowledge of the object.
observations.Beruf: The entry distinguishes an inner inclination or drive from motive/obligation and from an assigned office or way of life.

decision: Keep an inner-drive reading and a task/obligation reading as explicit candidates. Do not silently impose a profession, a legal command, or a divine/natural source.
